cand.title: 4th Digital Health Symposium 2027
cand.excerpt: High mechanism and local relevance, but current venue commitment limits accessibility.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Frédéric André, EHC Director of Information Systems, is the strongest named programme-organizer route: he publicly states that he organized and hosted the third symposium and names 14 January 2027 for the fourth. Caroline Boesch, institutional communications lead, is a relevant operational routing contact because the 2026 invitation is signed by the communications service. Mikael de Rham, Director General, is a secondary executive-sponsor route. No source establishes any of them as hotel contract signatory or housing budget owner. Speakers and prize presenters are not treated as buyers.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming fourth edition: 14 January 2027, Le Cube, Avenue de Vertou 2C, 1110 Morges, Vaud, Switzerland. Reception 13:30, introduction 14:00, networking aperitif 18:00; final closing time not published. This is a single-afternoon programme, within the requested horizon. The EHC article publication date, 19 October 2026, is not the activity date. No official 2028 edition announcement was found; do not assign a 2028 date.
findings.hotelProductFit: Assessment using the supplied YOTEL specifications: weak fit for relocation of the full symposium, conditional fit for smaller EHC training/workshops or verified airport-side speaker/project-team stays. The latest published attendance is more than 300 in 2026, exceeding YOTEL’s supplied approximately 250-theatre maximum; the 2025 figure of about 170 must not be used to assume the current event fits. 2027 attendance is unpublished. A half-day event at Le Cube does not establish overnight demand, let alone a 20–120-room group. Founex is not the host city and transfers would need explicit buyer acceptance. This is professional meeting demand, not a resort retreat, downtown-Geneva housing event or Palexpo overflow lead.
findings.venueCommitments: EHC explicitly announces “14 janvier 2027 | Le Cube, Morges”; the edition-specific ticket page supplies Avenue de Vertou 2C. Publicly confirmed venue allocation, not a reviewed signed contract. Le Cube is a multipurpose cultural/events building, not a hotel. Morges is in Vaud/La Côte, at the eastern end of the broader regional catchment, not Founex/Nyon, Geneva Airport corridor, Geneva city or Lausanne city. No 2027 room-within-venue is specified; Petra is verified for 2026 only.
findings.historicalRotation: 2024: first edition on 18 January, 120 health-sector professionals; Morges is identified in an EHC mirror, but exact venue remains unverified. 2025: 16 January, Le Cube, Morges, approximately 170 participants. 2026: 15 January, Le Cube, Salles Petra, Morges; EHC subsequently reported more than 300 participants. 2027: fourth edition confirmed at Le Cube on 14 January. Consecutive January editions establish observed yearly recurrence through 2027, not a guaranteed future annual contract. No destination rotation is evidenced; the verified 2025–2027 venues repeat Le Cube.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown. Neither the reviewed 2027 EHC announcement nor its linked ticket page publishes a housing bureau, host hotel, accommodation agent, room block, booking code, hotel list or open hotel RFP. No hotels are named in those edition-specific materials. Source wording: “Participation : CHF 30.– par personne” and “18h00 – Apéritif et networking”; ticket-page location: “Le Cube — Avenue de Vertou 2C, 1110 Morges”. These describe attendance and the programme venue, not lodging procurement. Absence of hotel information is not evidence of open sourcing or of no overnight stays.
findings.organizationStructure: EHC is the event owner/organizer: a private nonprofit healthcare association recognized as serving the public interest, not a sports/entertainment promoter, PCO or DMC. Reclassify the seed segment to healthcare / digital-health professional symposium. Antares Consulting was an organizing partner in 2024; that does not establish a 2027 PCO mandate. Infomaniak Events is the linked ticketing channel, not evidence of a housing-bureau appointment. Le Cube is the meeting venue, not the event owner.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The evidenced incumbent is Le Cube as meeting venue, repeated for 2025–2027; no incumbent hotel or housing bureau is established. The 2026 attendance of more than 300 is a material capacity warning against a full move to YOTEL. No sourced evidence of hotel sell-out, overflow rooms, rejected delegates, unmet lodging demand, or a venue-switch intention was found. Do not describe a published hotel allocation as committed elsewhere: none was identified.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: First approach Caroline Boesch through the published EHC communications route, referencing Frédéric André’s confirmed organizing role. Ask to be introduced to the person managing 2027 speaker travel/hotel needs and future small-group meetings. Establish whether any overnight rooms are required, nights and peak rooms, payer, existing hotel arrangements and transfer acceptability before pricing. If there is a qualified requirement, propose only the verified subset within the hotel’s supplied commercial band; do not quote a speculative block or whole-house use. After the 2027 event, request a debrief with André on smaller workshops and any genuinely planned next edition. Do not seek an RFP merely because none is public.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 meeting venue is publicly committed to Le Cube, so do not pitch replacement of the current main meeting as an open opportunity. Registration is open, but that is not a hotel sourcing signal. Ancillary lodging remains unconfirmed rather than committed to named competing hotels; pursue only if EHC identifies nonlocal overnight guests and accepts Founex transfers. No room revenue or room-night forecast is defensible.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Relationship-development hypothesis only: ask about separate, smaller digital-health workshops, training and project meetings that could use YOTEL’s supplied meeting capacities. Full future-symposium capture is constrained by repeat use of Le Cube and the latest historical attendance above 300. No 2028 edition date, venue procurement process or willingness to rotate was found. Any future pitch requires verified attendance, format, procurement timing and location flexibility; recurrence alone is not an open RFP.
